title: Chapter 479
paragraphs: Chapter 479
Episode 134. Duel on the Ship (1)
Mary shared all information with the higher-ranking knight, Diphus.
So, it wasn't strange that Mary knew something Jin didn't.
In fact, Jin had no idea what the big opportunity was since he first heard about it in Gaipa Military.
Although his comrades had been keeping an eye on other major issues he had in mind, there was no particular unusual trend.
'Hehe. As expected, Brother Diphus was right. It seems the reaction is coming right away, you little guy!'
Mary swallowed her laughter. She regretted not being able to enjoy his confused expression and the delicious face up close.
"Sister!"
As Jin opened his mouth, Mary turned around, her grin almost reaching her ears.
"What!"
"I was short-sighted! It's not polite to just send you back after you've come such a long way!"
"What did you say?"
"Please come up! I'll allow it!"
"I can't hear you!"
"I'm sorry, come up and let's talk!"
"Hahaha, I can't hear you! Say it again!"
Of course, she heard him clearly. She was just pretending not to hear him in order to tease her little brother.
Jin, of course, didn't show a flustered expression or a hint of discomfort as Mary had expected. Only Mary was overly excited.
Seeing the back of his sister, who was laughing with her hands on her hips, Jin felt a strange pity.
'Is it really that fun to her...? She seems to enjoy it like someone who has never had fun in their life.'
For Mary, it was a wonder that Jin had such a sloppy side. The small sense of victory was quite sweet.
Jin went along with Mary's prank for a while, and soon enough, everyone in Tichan saw her back and the fleet.
At first, both the comrades and the residents had the same thoughts as Mary. Jin seemed strange, going along with such a childish prank. This side of Jin was unfamiliar to everyone, not just Mary.
"Um, Captain. Maybe it's time to stop...? The atmosphere is gradually getting colder."
It was only after Cosmos spoke with difficulty that Mary stopped her prank.
When she turned around, she saw Jin's emotionless face and Murakan, who looked pitifully at her.
The others couldn't show their true feelings because she was Mary Runcandel, but deep down, they probably felt no different from Jin or Murakan.
'You should have told me earlier when things were turning out like this, you little brat.'
As Mary whispered, Cosmos nodded his head.
'Because it seemed like you'd hit me hard like last time...'
'It's different now, you know.'
'Don't worry, I'll try to lift the atmosphere again when I see an opening.'
As Cosmos stepped back, Mary met Jin's eyes again.
"Hmm! If you're going to welcome me that much, young one, I'll come up!"
Mary stepped on the outer wall and construction site and jumped up to the mansion garden.
"Hahaha! What's with that pirate eye patch, Mary Lundkendel! It suits you well."
"Hmph, this eye patch... let's just call it my pride."
"What? Pride? Did you lose one eye? Is it an honorable injury or something?"
"Or it could be vanity. You're still having fun, Lord Murakan."
Even though Mary had come up to the mansion, the people of Tican who had been watching didn't go back to their homes or workplaces.
"Ladies and gentlemen! I am Pirate Cosmos, the pirate king and strategist in the Hufest Harbor with Mary's permission! The reason our pirate crew came to Tican today is..."
Cosmos began to liven up the atmosphere outside.
Boom, bang!
Cannons fired again, and pirates on the deck blew fire from their mouths, showing off various skills and grabbing the attention of the crowd.
The crowd was already full of anticipation. Mary had shouted about the contest and duel in a voice that made the waters around Tican roar.
"I owed Cosmos a favor and planned to give him a chance to command a strategical ship, but you took the initiative, sister. How did you find out?"

After the compass theft incident, Cosmos's pirate crew had been chased by both Bement and Zipl. Jin had often worried about them in his heart, but Cosmos, who was nothing more than a pirate crew, had never been caught by the large forces.
"By chance, I stepped on the visible stuff and ran around. And I knew that guy from the past. I thought he was a pretty useful guy when he was young. Just right for doing errands while traveling."
"Traveling?"
"Hehe, yes. I recently had a goal of my own."
"What is your goal?"

"You don't need to know! There won't be any contract duels for a while after this. After deciding the ranking with you today, I plan to leave for a faraway, harsh land to find monsters and hidden masters."
I haven't agreed to the duel yet.
Normally, he would have answered that way and bought more time to observe the situation, while gaining some control.
But he couldn't do that looking at Mary's eyes.
The eyes of a person who has firmly resolved and made up their mind. Mary, who had been playful until now, had those eyes.
'What happened to her?'
Jin was unaware that the reason Mary started her journey with such determination was because of the recent actions he had shown.
'Anyway, seeing Mary like this... it seems the big event isn't going too urgently.'
If the situation had been urgent, the family would have undoubtedly deployed Mary as well.
It was a big deal that the first army of the four major forces clung to, even giving up on Amela, they couldn't have leisurely come here for a duel.
"It's an honor that our duel is included in your journey, sister. I will gratefully accept this match."
"Hehe, that's right! That's how it should be."
"In that sense, could you give me a hint about what kind of matter it is?"
"If you defeat me, I'll tell you."
"I'm worried that I might lose focus while fighting you because I'm too curious. Wouldn't that be disrespectful to you?"
That was half-sincere. If he had even a small clue, he might have figured it out, but he had been wandering around the Gaipa military district, feeling stifled.
"You're trying to use tricks again!"
"Sister, I've already seen and heard countless things. I promise not to run away with just a clue, please tell me."
Mary stared at Jin with piercing eyes.
Soon, she shrugged her shoulders as if she had no choice.
"It's Zipl, Jin."
Jin's pupils widened.
The members of the four major forces who had not come to the Gaipa military district were preparing to keep Zipl in check.
"Zipl, you say? Is it about the living golems or the new airships? Or... the cubes?"
From the standpoint of the four major forces, these were, of course, much more important and dangerous factors than Amella.
'Is it a research facility or a production site?'
Zipl. With that one word, a strong intuition stabbed his brain like a needle.
The research facility and production site for the living golems, the Cozec2 Myron, and the cubes. The major forces had discovered that place and were preparing to strike it.
"Hmm, it seems you've already caught on."
"I feel like my suspicions are being confirmed."

"I'll tell you more details if you defeat me. If you don't, it'll be as if we never spoke. The method is a one-on-one match, fighting until one side becomes combat-incapable. Let's finish this without killing or disabling each other."
"Alright. Do you have a place in mind?"
"No, I was thinking of fighting here?"
"Um, sister. It's embarrassing for me to say, but if you and I fight in earnest, there won't be anything left of Tikan."
Jin and Mary.
The two people who had risen to the ranks of superhumans had the power to easily devastate any area they fought in.
With the defense system construction still underway, the entire Tikan could collapse in an instant.
"It seems today was a rare day when my younger brother showed his naive side. You fool, do you think I would have suggested fighting here without knowing that? Hey, Cosmos!"
Mary turned her head to Cosmos and shouted.
"Tell me, Captain!"
"Prepare the stage!"
"Understood! Did you hear that, you smelly fellows! Prepare the stage! Now!"
Vroooom!
As Cosmos blew the horn, the ships forming the fleet began to move in an orderly manner.
The scattered ships gathered in an instant, and the space between the decks connected seamlessly, forming a plain-like area.
It was just like the arena of a martial arts tournament.

"As I just mentioned, this event is a one-on-one duel. And it's also a pure swordsmanship competition! The rules are simple. You and I will fight on the fleet. However, high-damage techniques that excessively damage the fleet are prohibited."
"Oh... I really like that, sister. Then Tikan won't be destroyed."
"You might still get destroyed. Let's start right away!"
Cosmos, who had been keeping the atmosphere lively and reading, cleared his throat once.
"Oooooh! Ladies and gentlemen, children and elders, thank you for waiting! Now, we will have a duel that will make your hearts burn, very, very hot! Are you all ready, everyone?!"
Yeeeeeessss!
Cosmos had completely captivated the crowd.
Indeed, he had experience running a martial arts tournament for a long time under his name.

"I can't help but feel excited, let's call out together! Of course, those who know and those who don't know, the greatest fighter of this era! The truly battle-crazed person! The Southern Continent's madwoman, ah, she doesn't like this nickname. And the stormy Mary! Her title always includes the word 'crazy'! Who is she! Who is she?!"
"Mary!"
"Mary Run Kandel!"
"That's right, it's Maaary-! Run, Kan, Del! I will now introduce her!"
Hop!
As Mary leaped onto the deck, thunderous cheers erupted from all around.
She seemed very familiar with such situations, waving her hand leisurely and smiling mischievously.
She also pointed at Jin with her index finger and provocatively drew her thumb across her neck.
